issuer.name: EEA: Wallester AS (Estonia, reg. 11812882) per the KuCard Terms of Use published 2024 — not confirmed by the current KuCoin EU help-centre pages. Australia: not disclosed on the pages read.

funding.supported_assets_note: Crypto-assets held on the KuCoin account are converted at payment time; they 'serve only as a funding source via conversion' and are never sent to merchants. EEA card settles in EUR (KuCoin EU sets the crypto conversion rate); Australian card settles in USDC (KuCoin AU sets the conversion rate, Mastercard the FX rate).

eligibility.usage_note: KuCoin EU help centre (updated 7 Oct 2026): 'exclusively available to EEA residents (not available in Malta)'; requires a KuCoin EU account with full KYC; 'no debit check'. Country list expanded by us from 'EEA' (30 states) minus Malta. The 2024 KuCard Terms of Use list the same 30 states including Malta — contradiction recorded; the newer, dated help-centre page governs. Age ≥ 18 per the Terms. Cardholders must stop using the card if they cease to reside in a permitted jurisdiction (Terms §3.3).

kyc.stages_note: Full KYC on the KuCoin EU account before applying; 'a valid EEA-issued ID document or passport' that is 'issued within the EEA' and unexpired. Terms §3.1: 'pass identity verification with a supported EEA-issued identity document'. Proof of address / selfie not stated on the pages read.

access.note: First virtual card free; no subscription tier.

fees.conditions: First virtual card free. Each additional virtual card €9.90 (fee schedule, 29 Sep 2026) — the apply guide (7 Oct 2026) says €9.99: contradiction recorded, fee schedule modelled. Physical card €9.90 (first), €19.90 (subsequent). Replacement €9.90. Max 5 cards.
Standard delivery cost not stated; express delivery €30 per card.
No monthly or annual fee listed in the fee schedule.

€2 per card per month after 90 consecutive calendar days without a completed transaction following activation; waived/refunded if cumulative transactions ≥ €100 within 1 month of being charged; 7 days' notice before deduction.

Euro transactions free; 'Non-euro transactions: 2% of transaction total' on top of Visa's exchange rate. A conversion spread on the crypto→EUR conversion also applies (rate set by KuCoin EU, not quantified).
€2 per withdrawal within Europe; internationally 2% of the amount plus €2. ATM operators may add their own fees.
The card is funded from the KuCoin EU account balance; the fee schedule does not price the crypto→EUR conversion beyond 'conversion spread … may apply'.

limits.note: Spending limits not stated on the EEA pages read ('KuCard Fees & Limits' article lists fees only; the Terms refer to a FAQ placeholder). Maximum 5 cards per user.

eligibility.usage_note: 'Currently, KuCard-AU is exclusively available to Australian residents' with a valid KuCoin AU account and full KYC; 'no debit check is required'. Minimum age not stated on the pages read. Variant currency recorded as USD because the card settles in USDC (a USD stablecoin); the applicant selects an estimated monthly spend in USD.

kyc.stages_note: Full KYC on the KuCoin AU account before applying: passport or Australian driving licence (document 'must be issued within Australia', valid and unexpired) plus an Australian residential address / proof of residence. Selfie not stated.

access.note: First virtual card free; no subscription tier. Physical card 'not currently supported' (to be opened in the future).

fees.conditions: First virtual card free; each additional virtual card 9.99 USDC (up to 4 more, 5 cards in total). Replacement fee not listed. Dispute fee 30 USDC per transaction.

2 USDC per card per month after 90 consecutive calendar days without a completed transaction following activation; waived if cumulative transactions ≥ 100 USDC within one month of the charge; 7 days' notice.
'Transaction fee: 0.5% of transaction total' on every card payment (in addition to any FX fee and the crypto conversion spread).

'Foreign exchange fee: 1% of transaction total' when the transaction currency is not USDC, calculated on the converted amount; Mastercard sets the exchange rate. Note: as the card settles in USDC, AUD purchases in Australia are non-USDC transactions.
Not mentioned on any page read; the card is virtual-only at present.
Funded from the KuCoin AU account via conversion; a 'spread fee … calculated from real-time exchange rates' applies but is not quantified.

limits.note: 20,000 USDC per day (UTC) and 200,000 USDC per year, aggregated across all the user's KuCards (blog, 30 Apr 2026). The help-centre 'Fees & Limits' article (21 Jul 2026) lists no limits.

evidence.excerpt: Last updated 09/29/2026. First virtual card free; additional virtual €9.90; physical €9.90 first / €19.90 subsequent; replacement €9.90; cancellation free; EUR transactions free; non-EUR 2%; ATM Europe €2, international 2% + €2; declined payment free; express delivery €30; overdraft 'currently unavailable'. Settled in EUR; Visa FX rate; KuCoin EU conversion rate.

'Exclusively available to EEA residents (not available in Malta)'; KuCoin EU account with full KYC; valid EEA-issued ID or passport, unexpired; no debit check; physical card via Add flow with an application fee in EUR (amount not shown); 'from the second virtual card onward, the fee is €9.99 per card'; max 5 cards.

evidence.excerpt: Last updated 10/09/2026. 'Inactivity fee (monthly): €2 per card' after 90 consecutive days without completed transactions post-activation; EUR deductions from the Funding Account; 7-day notice; waiver/refund with ≥ €100 cumulative transactions within 1 month of the charge; card may be suspended if the fee cannot be collected.

Malta); EEA citizens/residents only; ≥ 18; §3.1 EEA-issued identity document; default spending currency USDT, settlement EUR; Estonian law. evidence.title: How is KuCard-AU charged for use? — Fees & Limits (KuCoin AU help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Last updated 07/21/2026. First virtual card free; additional virtual 9.99 USDC (up to 4); cancellation free; annual fee free; transaction fee 0.5%; FX fee 1% on non-USDC transactions (Mastercard rate); spread fee from real-time rates; declined payment free; overdraft unavailable; inactive fee 2 USDC/card/month; dispute fee 30 USDC. 'All KuCard transactions are settled in USDC.' No limits listed.

evidence.title: All You Need to Know About Fees and Limits of KuCard-AU (KuCoin blog, 30 Apr 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Same fee schedule as the help centre (free first virtual card, 9.99 USDC additional, annual free, 2 USDC monthly inactivity after 90 days, 0.5% transaction fee, 1% FX, 30 USDC dispute). Limits: 20,000 USDC daily and 200,000 USDC annual spending, aggregated across up to 5 cards, UTC days. Inactivity waiver ≥ 100 USDC within one month; 7-day notice.

evidence.title: How to apply for KuCard-AU (KuCoin AU help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Last updated 07/21/2026. 'Exclusively available to Australian residents'; KuCoin AU account with full KYC; passport or Australian driving licence issued within Australia, unexpired; Australian residential address/proof of residence; no debit check; max 5 cards; monthly spend estimate chosen in USD. Footer: Echuca Trading Pty Ltd (AFSL 297499) issues derivatives — not stated to cover KuCard.

evidence.title: What Is KuCard-AU? And How Can I Apply for a KuCard-AU? (KuCoin blog, 27 Apr 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Mastercard debit card; crypto converted to fiat at payment; 'exclusively available to Australian residents'; full KYC (passport or Australian driving licence, Australian address); virtual only, 'physical cards will be opened in the future'; max 5 cards; Apple Pay/Google Pay; USDC settlement; first virtual card free, additional 9.99 USDC; rewards rates 'not guaranteed'. Issuer not named.

evidence.title: Comprehensive Guide of Rewards and Benefits of KuCard-AU (KuCoin AU blog, 15 May 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Cashback by KuCoin VIP level: VIP 0 1%/1.5%/2% (assets 0–10k/10–20k/20k+ USDT; caps 10/20/30 USDC/month), VIP 1–4 3% (cap 60), VIP 5–7 4% (cap 90), VIP 8–10 6% (cap 135), VIP 11–12 8% (cap 200); paid on the 15th monthly; excludes ATM, cash advances, USDC-settled transactions; rates 'not guaranteed'. SUPERSEDED by the Rewards Points Program on 16 Jul 2026.

evidence.title: KuCard Rewards Points Explained (KuCoin blog, 14 Aug 2026)
evidence.excerpt: KuCoin AU: cashback replaced on 16 Jul 2026 by a Rewards Points Program; legacy cashback redeemable until 12 Jan 2027. Points = spend × reward rate × 1,000; rate = higher of VIP-level rate or monthly spending tier — no rate table on the page. 1,000 points ≈ 1 USDC; 15-business-day verification; points expire after 90 days. Excludes ATM, gambling, brokerage, transfers, top-ups.

evidence.title: KuCoin Affiliate Program (official page)
evidence.excerpt: 'Earn up to 60% commission' on referred users' spot and futures trading fees, multi-tier; open to creators (> 5,000 followers or > 500 community members), crypto websites/media, marketers and institutions; apply via affiliate-apply page; attribution by referral link. KuCard not mentioned; payout terms not stated.

changelog.reason: Initial record (single read, unattended research run) from KuCoin EU help-centre fee/apply/inactivity articles (Sep–Oct 2026), KuCoin AU help-centre fees/apply articles (Jul 2026), KuCoin AU blog articles (Apr–Aug 2026), the 2024 KuCard Terms of Use and the affiliate page. Two EEA variants' contradictions recorded (€9.90 vs €9.99 additional virtual card; Malta). Issuer is a hypothesis (EEA) / undisclosed (AU); network differs by region (Visa EEA per 2024 Terms, Mastercard AU). Global support articles (kucoin.com/support/…) are client-rendered and returned empty shells. Rewards: AU points programme without a published rate; EEA 'Benefits and Rewards' article unreadable.

editorial.summary: KuCoin's exchange-linked debit card, offered as two separate regional products: a EUR card for EEA residents (not Malta) through KuCoin EU, and a USDC-settled virtual Mastercard for Australian residents through KuCoin AU. Free first virtual card in both regions; a €2 / 2 USDC monthly inactivity fee after 90 idle days; the EEA card charges 2% on non-euro spending, the Australian card 0.5% on every transaction plus 1% FX on non-USDC transactions. No reward with a published rate.
good_for: Existing KuCoin EU or KuCoin AU customers who want to spend their exchange balance
Euro-zone spending with the EEA card (no transaction fee in EUR)
not_for: Residents outside the EEA (excluding Malta) or Australia
Anyone counting on cashback: the Australian points programme publishes no rate and the EEA rewards page could not be read
Australian users paying in AUD who want to avoid per-transaction fees (0.5% + 1% FX because the card settles in USDC)
watch_outs: Inactivity fee of €2 / 2 USDC per card per month after 90 days without a transaction.

The card issuer for the EEA card is only named in a 2024 Terms of Use page with template placeholders (Wallester AS, Visa); the current KuCoin EU pages name neither issuer nor network. The Australian issuer is not disclosed.
Two official EEA pages disagree on the additional-virtual-card fee (€9.90 vs €9.99) and on Malta; the dated fee schedule and the newer eligibility page are modelled.

Australia: the May 2026 cashback table (1–8% by VIP level) was replaced on 16 July 2026 by a points programme whose rate is 'the higher of the VIP rate or the monthly spending tier' with no table published — treated as unknown.
Spending limits for the EEA card are not published on the pages read; Australian limits (20,000 USDC/day) come from a blog post, not the help centre.
